---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something the app should do
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What you want to do

The thing you cannot do today, described from the outside: what you would tap, and what you
would expect to happen.

## Why it matters

What it costs you to not have it. If the reference Harmony client does it, say where.

## Alternatives you have tried

Anything that gets you part of the way today, and why it is not enough.

## Would you work on it?

- [ ] Yes, I can implement this
- [ ] Yes, with guidance
- [ ] No, but I can test it
- [ ] No, just suggesting

## Before filing

The app is not parity-complete. Check
[docs/parity-audit.md](https://github.com/WWPOL/harmony-android/blob/master/docs/parity-audit.md)
first: if the gap is already recorded there (encryption, push, uploads and several other flows
are), an issue adding detail to that row is more useful than a new one.
